items.title: Prime Minister and Minister for Climate and the Environment host lunch discussions ahead of COP31
items.summary: On Wednesday 4 November, the Swedish companies participating in the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) gathered at the invitation of Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson and Minister for Climate and the Environment Romina Pourmokhtari. The aim of the lunch discussions was to identify Swedish priorities and lay the foundations for strong Swedish business engagement at COP31.

items.title: Strategy for Sweden's development cooperation with Kenya 2026–2031
items.summary: The aim of Sweden’s international development assistance is to create conditions that improve the lives of people living in poverty and oppression. At the same time, development cooperation is a key foreign policy tool and can help to promote and safeguard Sweden’s interests and priorities.

items.title: Prime Minister receives Hungarian Speaker Ágnes Forsthoffer
items.summary: On Wednesday 4 November, Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson received Speaker of the Hungarian National Assembly Ágnes Forsthoffer at Sager House for a courtesy visit. The visit was the first by a Hungarian speaker for more than 20 years and coincided with the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian Revolution of 1956.

items.title: Styrräntan höjs till 2 procent
items.summary: Ett starkare konjunkturläge i kombination med kostnadsökningar till följd av utbudsstörningar gör att inflationen förväntas stiga framöver. Direktionen har därför beslutat att höja styrräntan med 0,25 procentenheter till 2 procent. Om inflations- och konjunkturutsikterna står sig är det sannolikt att styrräntan höjs ytterligare det närmaste året, i linje med styrränteprognosen i september.

items.title: Riksbanken planerar att finansiera en del av valutareserven med valutalån via Riksgälden
items.summary: För att minska valutarisken på balansräkningen planerar Riksbanken att finansiera motsvarande cirka 200 miljarder kronor av valutareserven med valutalån via Riksgälden. Avsikten är också att ersätta de valutaswappar som Riksbanken använt sedan 2023 för valutasäkring. Förändringen syftar inte till att påverka storleken på valutareserven över tid och har inget penningpolitiskt syfte.

items.title: Benjamin Dousa visits South America
items.summary: Minister for International Development Cooperation and Foreign Trade Benjamin Dousa is visiting Argentina and Brazil on 2–6 November to reinforce trade relations with two of Sweden’s most important partners in South America and promote opportunities resulting from the free trade agreement between the EU and MERCOSUR. The visit also highlights the 200th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Sweden and Brazil.

items.summary: Singapore’s President Tharman Shanmugaratnam is paying a State Visit to Sweden at the invitation of HM The King. President Tharman is accompanied by his wife, Jane Ittogi Shanmugaratnam, and representatives of Singapore’s Government and the Singaporean business sector.

items.title: The Folke Bernadotte Academy’s new Strategy for peace and security engagement 2026–2031
items.summary: The Folke Bernadotte Academy’s new Strategy for peace and security engagement 2026–2031 aims to make the governance of the FBA more coherent and flexible. This will strengthen Sweden’s role in peace and security promotion in the context of a deteriorating international situation with a historically high number of armed conflicts and democratic backsliding.
